top_signals.title: Netflix Brings in New Executive to Spur Growth
top_signals.summary: Netflix Inc. is replacing its chief creative officer with Peter Rice, a veteran TV and film executive, as it tries to spur growth and find new hits. He'll be in charge of scripted and unscripted series, film and live events across all regions. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Global Gas Crunch Makes Europe’s Remaining Coal Plants Profitable
top_signals.summary: The global LNG supply crunch has made Europe’s last-standing coal-fired power plants profitable this year as gas supply costs soar while the need for conventional generation to stabilize grids remains. In Germany and Poland, which host most of the remaining operational or back-up-ready coal power capacity in Europe, coal-fired generation is profitable again as winter approaches, LNG supply is barely moving out of the Strait of Hormuz, and gas prices are at their highest level since the 2022-2023 crisis.
